title: Place autonomy inside a controlled boundary
description: Choose a workload and an execution shape. Add durable state or a human release gate only when the workload contract requires them.

modes.label: Crew only
modes.detail: Specialists collaborate under one crew process.

modes.label: Flow only
modes.detail: Python steps and named routes own the path.

modes.label: Flow with a crew
modes.detail: The flow controls state and invokes a crew for one bounded assignment.

workloads.label: Exploratory market brief
workloads.detail: Research, challenge, and synthesize an open-ended question with no external write.
workloads.failure: A rigid flow adds control surface without improving this bounded, collaborative deliverable.

workloads.label: Webhook ticket triage
workloads.detail: Validate an event, classify it, and route it to one named queue.
workloads.failure: An autonomous crew makes a known routing path harder to test and recover.

workloads.label: Regulated recommendation
workloads.detail: Specialists assemble evidence, then a reviewer accepts or rejects the recommendation.
workloads.failure: The run needs both bounded collaboration and an application-owned release decision.

workloads.label: Long-running record enrichment
workloads.detail: Resume a multi-step data pipeline after dependency failures without repeating accepted work.
workloads.failure: Without durable state, a retry can repeat completed steps and lose the recovery boundary.
